announcements.title: Official Signed Fedora RPM & Arch Pacman Repositories Live
announcements.summary: PatchCraft Launcher v2.0.0 is now live on signed native DNF/Zypper and Pacman repositories at repo.patchcraft.dev, delivering automatic updates on Fedora, Nobara, RHEL, openSUSE, Arch Linux, CachyOS, EndeavourOS, and Manjaro.
bullets: **Fedora / RHEL / Nobara / openSUSE**: Add `https://repo.patchcraft.dev/rpm/patchcraft.repo` and install via `sudo dnf install -y patchcraft-launcher` for automatic GPG-verified `dnf upgrade` updates.

**Arch Linux / CachyOS / EndeavourOS / Manjaro**: Import `https://repo.patchcraft.dev/gpg.asc`, add `[patchcraft]` (`https://repo.patchcraft.dev/arch/$arch`), and install with `sudo pacman -Syu patchcraft-launcher` — no AUR helper required.
**Full GPG Verification**: Packages, RPM `repomd.xml.asc`, and Pacman `patchcraft.db.sig` databases are all signed and verified end-to-end.

announcements.title: Ubuntu Launchpad PPA (26.04, 24.04, 22.04) & Snap Store Live
announcements.summary: Linux Jagex Launcher v1.5.0 is live on ppa:danielcook2016/linux-jagex-launcher for Ubuntu 26.04, 24.04, and 22.04 alongside Canonical Snap Store latest/stable (Rev 10), keeping native installs updated automatically.
bullets: **Ubuntu PPA**: Published cleanly for Ubuntu 26.04 Resolute, 24.04 Noble, and 22.04 Jammy on `ppa:danielcook2016/linux-jagex-launcher`.
**Snap Store**: Canonical Snap `latest/stable` updated to `v1.5.0` (Rev 10) with Wayland/X11 desktop integration.
**Community Standards**: Repository ships issue forms, PR checklist, contributing guide, security policy, and Code of Conduct.

announcements.title: Arch (.pacman) & Fedora (.rpm) Packages Hosted Directly on GitHub Releases
announcements.summary: Native Arch Linux (.x64.pacman) and Fedora/RHEL (.x86_64.rpm) packages alongside AppImage, .deb, and portable .tar.gz archives are hosted directly on every GitHub Release.
bullets: **Arch Linux**: Install the `.x64.pacman` package from GitHub Releases using `sudo pacman -U` or build locally via `packaging/aur/PKGBUILD`.
**Fedora & RHEL**: Install the `.x86_64.rpm` package directly with `sudo dnf install -y` from GitHub Releases.
**Verified Checksums**: Every release publishes `SHA256SUMS.txt` verified automatically by the built-in launcher updater.
